Automated Image Quality Control for DICOM Volumes

Source: R/qc.R
dicom_image_qc.Rd

Evaluates signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR), field-of-view (FOV) border truncation, slice spacing regularity, gantry tilt, and high-frequency striping/ringing artifacts on a dicom_volume.

Usage

dicom_image_qc(
  vol,
  snr_warn = 5,
  border_threshold_frac = 0.05,
  artifact_warn = 0.35,
  artifact_fail = 0.65,
  tilt_warn_deg = 1
)

Arguments

vol

A dicom_volume object.

snr_warn

Minimum acceptable SNR before raising a warning (default 5.0).

border_threshold_frac

Maximum fraction of FOV perimeter voxels allowed above the foreground threshold before flagging border truncation (default 0.05).

artifact_warn

High-frequency artifact score threshold for "WARN" (default 0.35).

artifact_fail

High-frequency artifact score threshold for "FAIL" (default 0.65).

tilt_warn_deg

Maximum slice-normal tilt angle in degrees before flagging tilt_anomaly (default 1.0).

Value

A list with components snr, cnr, border_truncation, spacing_anomaly, tilt_anomaly, artifact_score, qc_status ("PASS", "WARN", or "FAIL"), and issues (character vector).
